articles.summary: York Regional Police (YRP) are appealing for witnesses to come forward after a fatal two-vehicle collision in Vaughan on Sunday night. articles.title: 'Up to 2 hours in a car': Liberty Village residents share what they want the next mayor to fix
articles.summary: Traffic is hands down the biggest issue in Liberty Village — at least according to the residents we spoke with. Other top concerns? Street cleanliness and, well ... dog poop. This is the second installment of our new series, Toronto Speaks, where CBC’s Alejandrina Alvarez heads to neighbourhoods across the city to hear what matters most to people in their community.

articles.title: York police arrest 5, dismantle alleged criminal drug network operating through dark web
articles.summary: York police say they have arrested five people and dismantled a criminal network operating through the dark web following a months-long investigation.

articles.title: How Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ became the longest-running No. 1 hit of all time
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas,” a simmering, midtempo, country-and-then-some heartbreak song released last October, is indisputably 2026’s biggest hit.

articles.title: DoorDash to pay $131M for underpaying delivery workers in New York City
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle claims that it underpaid delivery workers in New York City, Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced Tuesday.

articles.title: 2 people found dead in separate vehicle fires within hours of each other in Etobicoke and Scarborough
articles.summary: Emergency services responded to two fatal vehicle fires within hours of each other Monday night and early Tuesday.

articles.title: 18 injured in suspected arson at Mississauga apartment building
articles.summary: Residents in a Mississauga apartment building are shaken after a fire Monday morning, which police say may have been arson, sent at least 18 people to the hospital, including a firefighter and a police officer.

articles.title: 2 dead after shooting outside Scarborough seniors' medical centre: police
articles.summary: Two people are dead following a shooting outside a seniors’ medical centre in Scarborough Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Peel Regional Police Association endorses Alvin Tedjo in Mississauga mayoral race
articles.summary: The association is endorsing a candidate in Mississauga’s municipal campaign for what the organization says is the first time in its history. The Peel police union's president said Monday that Tedjo "understands that public safety is not just a slogan, it's a responsibility."

articles.title: Ontario launches project to refurbish 4 nuclear reactors at Pickering plant
articles.summary: An Ontario nuclear plant is beginning a massive refurbishment project today, as Premier Doug Ford's government looks to lean heavily on nuclear energy to serve the province's growing electricity needs.
